mentor_vs_advisor.answer_zh: 導師（Mentor）負責學習輔助，指導教授（Advisor）負責論文及研究指導，兩者可能不同。如果需要確認您的導師是誰，請填寫google 表單: https://forms.gle/mcSMskAWNcDgSzJN7， 並查看您的電子郵件以獲取結果。
mentor_vs_advisor.answer_en: A mentor handles coursework guidance, while an advisor supervises your thesis and research. They may be different people. If you need to confirm who is your mentor, please fill out the form  at  https://forms.gle/mcSMskAWNcDgSzJN7, and check your email for the result.

seminar_rule.answer_zh: Seminar課程(專題討論課程)應選擇mentor(導師)，而不是advisor(指導教授)。
seminar_rule.answer_en: For seminar courses, you should select your mentor, not your advisor.
